name: econ-data-analysis
description: Principle-based guide for rigorous economic data analysis with jupytext logging and multi-source validation

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous economic data analysis with three core principles.
interface.longDescription: Guide for manipulating economic and financial datasets following three principles: describe before analyzing, log everything in jupytext percent format, and validate against multiple sources. Includes a data-analysis-reviewer agent and pitfall checklists.
defaultPrompt: Use Econ Data Analysis to guide this data analysis following the three principles of rigorous economic data work.
